title: Which RP IDs a page can use
desc: Nested domains for a page at the origin https://login.example.com. The outermost box is com, which is not a valid RP ID. Inside it, example.com is a valid RP ID. Inside that, login.example.com, the page's own domain, is a valid RP ID. Inside that, m.login.example.com is not a valid RP ID. The valid RP IDs are login.example.com and example.com, not m.login.example.com and not com.

children.title: example.com
children.sub: a registrable domain suffix of the page's domain
